description: This file defines the ClusterManifestSystemTarget class, which manages cluster manifest data, including retrieving current manifests and updates, and participating in the silo lifecycle within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: ClusterManifestSystemTarget
classes.description: Manages cluster manifest data, including fetching current manifests and updates, and lifecycle participation within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Returns an update to the cluster manifest if newer than the provided version.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle; in this case, no action is taken.
